smoothing.what: the two inner edges and the bank's width; the outer edges are the built ones, unmoved

heights.datum: the built west edge: its place and height are kept; the measured shape across the road is laid onto it

datum_shift_m._doc: built west edge minus the lidar there: how far every height here stands off the lidar

edges._doc: offsets from the OLD line per station of the two roads, + = west: what the scene rows are built to (the mainline row = sb_west, its line, sb_east; the piece row = nb_west, its line, nb_east)
edges._doc_y: SURFACE heights of the same four edges (a row is west edge, line + LIFT, east edge: tilted, not flat)

lap_zone._doc: the Speedway lap through the zone, one point per mainline station (south join, the piece, north join)
